project_diagnostics.message: voiceKey `hero-0020` is shared by 2 lines with different text, so one recording would voice all of them: `other.lute` hero.s01ep02.hero_0020 "Farewell."; `source.lute` hero.s01ep01.hero_0020 "Goodbye."; a voiceKey template without `{prefix}` (such as the 0.21 default `{speaker}-{code}`) repeats across documents — use the default `{prefix}.{speaker}-{code}` in lute.project.yaml's `identity.voiceKey` (renames every voice asset) or give the lines distinct `code=`s
